verdict.rationale: Zero is an open-source email app that could plausibly ship official SDKs, so the axis applies. The pack never mentions an SDK in any language. The only programmatic surface is an MCP server described in prose, authenticated with a copied browser session cookie, and an independent check found no public HTTP API or endpoint schema. MCP capabilities and the generic "Developer-Friendly" tagline belong to other stories and do not count as SDK support here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
